scientific_integrity: The joint process theorem is proved by exact factorial moments and Bell-number asymptotics; mean-gap convergence requires a fourth-moment uniform-integrability argument. Finite checks are diagnostic, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: No finite-n rate or total-variation estimate is claimed. Broad historical implicit derivability from known sparse exchangeable point-process results remains possible. No independent audit has been performed.
title: Independent endpoint Poisson laws and the sharp singleton-gap scale in uniform set partitions
